title: Getting to Work in a Big City
text:
Many people in large cities spend hours every day on their daily commute. Traffic congestion has become so severe that some drivers now choose to take the bus or the metro instead. Local governments hope that these changes will reduce air pollution.

However, public transport is only a real alternative when it is reliable and affordable. Many commuters complain that buses arrive late and that tickets are expensive. Experts therefore argue that cities should invest more in fast and comfortable services.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, why have some drivers started to use buses or the metro?
options: Cars are no longer allowed in the city
The metro is only for tourists

questions.text: What do many commuters complain about in the second paragraph?
options: Buses arrive late and tickets are expensive
There are no buses at night

questions.text: What does the author imply about public transport?
options: It must be reliable and affordable to attract people
It is only useful for tourists
It should be replaced by cars
It is already perfect in all cities

questions.text: What can be inferred about the goals of local governments?
options: They plan to close all metro lines
They are not interested in pollution

vocabulary.definition: a regular journey between home and work
a situation where too many vehicles block the roads
able to be trusted to work well

paragraph_translations: Багато людей у великих містах щодня витрачають години на дорогу на роботу. Затори на дорогах стали настільки серйозними, що деякі водії тепер вибирають автобус або метро. Місцева влада сподівається, що ці зміни зменшать забруднення повітря.

Однак громадський транспорт є справжньою альтернативою лише тоді, коли він надійний і доступний. Багато пасажирів скаржаться, що автобуси запізнюються, а квитки дорогі. Тому експерти стверджують, що міста мають більше інвестувати в швидкі та комфортні послуги.
